lines.text: Koala fingerprints look almost exactly like ours.
And the reason why is even stranger.
Under a microscope, scientists could barely tell them apart.
Koalas even have two thumbs on each hand.
Yet their cousins, wombats and kangaroos, have no fingerprints at all.
Koalas evolved them on their own, separately from us.
The likely reason? A better grip on branches and eucalyptus leaves.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
